items.title: feat(hooks): only a test: commit may change test files, checked at commit and rechecked at land
items.summary:
## Why

Most TDD cheating happens after the RED test exists: a GREEN step loosens or edits the test until it passes, or writes the test to fit the code. Nothing stops that today. `hooks/git/commit-msg` checks only the conventional type and the `#<n>` anchor, and `scripts/review.sh:69-70` only catches it after the fact, by turning `tests_weakened` / `tdd_followed=false` into blockers, which depends on a model reading the diff well. items.title: `StaticStructureFactorDirect` only samples k vectors in the positive octant
items.summary:
### Description

After some recent freuding, I stumbled upon a possible bug in the diffraction module. It appears that when generating the grid of vectors, it is only sampling one octant (positive in all axes of the 3D grid) because of the use of unsigned int type, which can never be negative. For istropic systems (e.g., liquids) it wouldn't affect the results, as all octants are essentially the same, but issues arise with anisotropic systems (semicrystalline polymers in my case).
